description: This file defines the AuthenticationConfig interface in Java, which provides configuration methods for gateway authentication settings, including proxy configuration, OAuth setup, and DevOps resource configuration.

classes.name: AuthenticationConfig
classes.description: Interface defining methods to retrieve various authentication-related configurations, including proxy settings, OAuth configuration, and flags for pre-authentication and dummy authentication. Also contains an enumeration for config value paths and default values.

methods.name: getHttpProxyConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration of the HTTP proxy used by the gateway.

methods.name: getOAuthConfig
methods.description: Returns the OAuth configuration for supported authorization servers.

methods.name: isDummyAuthenticationEnabled
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if dummy authentication is enabled; defaults to the same value as pre-authentication enabled.

methods.name: getDevOpsConfig
methods.description: Returns the DevOps resource configuration settings.
